links.outcome: Readability of LLM responses to parent questions about rickets across five indices
links.effect: Readability varied substantially across models; Gemini 3 Pro produced more detailed but linguistically complex responses, indicating a trade-off between informational depth and accessibility.
links.quote: Readability analysis revealed substantial variability across models, indicating a trade-off between informational depth and accessibility.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the performance, clinical appropriateness, and readability of three LLMs answering patient/parent-oriented questions about rickets using expert clinician reviewers, but it evaluates model capabilities without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
